name: Lauren
source:
Lauren is the owner of Valarie studio and takes the role of a painter going through art block.
She is often taken as naive for listening to her heart instead of her brain when its about judging others.
She is kind and funny. Her personality is cheerful and caring, but whenever a bad situation happens she tends to lose her optimistic side to her fears and turn herself into a drama queen.

Lauren doesn't catch onto things easily. She is also a bad liar and has trouble in making decisions in certain cases.
As she goes through the game, she slowly starts to realise the world surrounding her, the true faces of people she thought she knew and how her problem actually looks like.
